label: The High-Level System Designer
tagline: One node in a larger system — legible, not a destination.
cluster_explainer: The Broker cluster positions the engine for other people — the deliverable is a forwarded URL, not a pitch.
demo_highlights: Icosahedron primitive (20 faces, geodesic) reads as a system node — topology visible at a glance, not a polished consumer shape.
Step envelope makes state transitions explicit, mirroring how system designers talk about discrete signal edges, not continuous waves.
Neon preset evokes network/system-mapping aesthetics without committing to a platform brand — fits 'node, not destination.'
Mid-band dominance matches architectural thinking: not sub-bass rumble, not treble shimmer, but the connective tissue of a system.
Deep cyan against neon signal renders the engine as something to read, not to consume — a single visit, like inspecting a building.
